payload.title: A platform failure is retryable only when nothing was created
payload.context: PublishPostJob re-sends automatically on retryable failures. Timeouts and server errors on a publish call are ambiguous: the platform may have created the post.
payload.rationale: Adapters mark a publish failure retryable only for a definite rejection (rate limit) or a connection that was never made. Everything ambiguous is permanent with outcome_unknown in the context. GraphClient calls default to not safe to repeat.
payload.consequences: Some posts that could have been retried safely end as failed and need a human. A duplicate public post is treated as worse than a missed one.
